title: Build a bounded QR symbol
responsibility: Encodes short printable ASCII text as QR modules and a drawing path.

inputs.name: qrSymbol.text
inputs.description: Nonempty text of at most 320 characters using printable ASCII from ! through ~; spaces, control characters and non-ASCII text are refused.

outputs.name: qrLimits
outputs.description: Limits of 320 input bytes, four quiet modules around the symbol, at most 77 modules per side and error-correction level M.

outputs.name: qrSymbol
outputs.description: The module count per side, quiet-margin size and SVG-style path of dark horizontal runs offset by the margin. The caller draws the symbol; no image file is written.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when text fails the allowed character/length checks or the generated symbol exceeds 77 modules. QR-library failures can also propagate.
